evidence: tools/green_check.py:552 `return 1 if args.strict and report["counts"]["red"] else 0`; tools/green_check.py:437-439 `rows = [{"book": book, "verdict": by.get(book, {}).get("verdict", "absent")} ...]` / `not_green = [row["book"] for row in rows if row["verdict"] != "green"]` (the profile gate never consults `deps_moved_since` or `certified_archived`, unlike gate() at :398-401, which maps deps-moved to "stale", and green_at_these_bytes at :127-130). tools/cut_release.sh:306-307 runs exactly these two as the cut's check. planning/release-v6.6.0.md:187 describes them as "every book green at its current digest in a committed manifest".
fix: Make --strict fail on every verdict other than green (red, never, absent), as the release doc says. In profile_gate, judge each row with green_at_these_bytes(record) and report "stale" or "unarchived" separately. If a red-only mode is still wanted, give it its own flag (--red-only).

reviewer: tools/green_check.py:552 strict exit counts only red, so 'never'/'absent' books pass `--strict`. profile_gate (:430-441) maps verdict straight from books_by_verdict and never consults deps_moved_since or certified_archived, unlike gate() (:398-401) and green_at_these_bytes (:127-136). audit() (:302-306) leaves verdict 'green' with deps_moved set when no exact_green exists. cut_release.sh:305-307 runs exactly these two commands as gate 05, and release-v6.6.0.md:187 says they mean 'green at its current digest in a committed manifest'. Mitigations: an absent book inside the default closure is caught by the profile gate, because absent != green. Part (c) is mostly unreachable, because the cut must run in a clean `git worktree add --detach build/cut-tree` (cut_release.sh:230), so build/acl2 is normally empty there. Part (b), a stale green whose dependency moved, is fully reachable and counts as green in the release gate.
scenario: (a) A lane adds books/new-thing.lisp to ACL2_BOOKS and nobody certifies it. Its verdict is "absent" (or "never" after a failed-to-attribute run), counts["red"] stays 0, and `green_check.py --strict` exits 0. cut_release.sh then reports the closure as certified. (b) A book in the default image closure has a green run at its own bytes, but a dependency changed since that run. audit() sets verdict "green" with deps_moved non-empty (:303-306), and profile_gate counts it green. (c) The only green is a local build/acl2 manifest that was never filed (archived=False). The profile gate accepts it as well. So the release cut certifies a closure whose certificate key no committed manifest backs.
title: Release gate green_check --strict / --profile passes books that are never certified, stale, or green only in a local unarchived manifest
